The Respondent issued a show cause notice dated March 18, 2022 to pay ineligible Input Tax Credits amounting to Rs. 18.69 million availed on Goods and Services Tax (“GST”) alongside penalty of 10% in keeping with Section 50(3) of the Central Goods and Services Tax Act of 2017.
